title: Adjacency in the padded graph
statement: Let $r$ be a decidable symmetric relation on the finite set $\text{Fin}(n)$, and let $D$ be a natural number with $n \le D$. In the padded multigraph defined from $r$ using degree parameter $D$, vertices $u,v \in \text{Fin}(n)$ are adjacent exactly when $u=v$ or $r(u,v)$ holds.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number n and a decidable relation r on Fin(n)
Vertices u and v in Fin(n)
